inbox.intro: See what AI suggested, decide what stays, and check changes made automatically.
inbox.caughtUpNote: New suggestions and automatic changes to check will appear here.
inbox.noMatchNote: Try another view or choose a different agent.
inbox.headingAttention: {count, plural, one {# item needs review} other {# items need review}}
inbox.headingAll: {count, plural, one {# AI update} other {# AI updates}}
inbox.status.waiting: {count, plural, one {# change waiting for your decision} other {# changes waiting for your decision}}
inbox.revertWithNoteQuote: The changes in “{title}” are taken back, and the agent is told why.
inbox.stats.title: AI activity
inbox.stats.intro: What each agent suggested and what your team chose.
inbox.revertDialog.title: Revert these AI changes?
inbox.revertDialog.document: This removes the changes from this AI edit in “{title}”. Later document edits may prevent the revert.
inbox.revertDialog.database: This removes the changes from this AI edit in “{title}”. Later edits to the same rows may be lost.
catchUp.docTitle: {count, plural, one {{agent} made # edit to this document} other {{agent} made # edits to this document}}
catchUp.docDescription: Applied directly, as this document is set to.
catchUp.alreadyUndone: These changes were already undone — nothing left to revert.
catchUp.documentChanged: Document has changed since — use version history instead.
catchUp.revertDescription: Returns the document to before {agent}’s run. If it changed too much, use version history.
catchUp.revertDescriptionAnyAgent: Returns the document to before the agent’s run. If it changed too much, use version history.
catchUp.dismissDescription: {agent}’s changes stay. This also removes the quick Revert; version history remains.
catchUp.dismissDescriptionAnyAgent: The agent’s changes stay. This also removes the quick Revert; version history remains.
catchUp.dbTitle: {count, plural, one {{agent} made # change to this database} other {{agent} made # changes to this database}}
catchUp.dbDescription: Applied directly, as this database is set to.
catchUp.dbRevertDescription: Reverts this run where possible. Later edits to the same rows may be lost.
runBar.docTitle: {count, plural, one {{agent} proposes # edit} other {{agent} proposes # edits}}
runBar.unshown: {count, plural, one {# can’t be shown in the document — see “Review each”} other {# can’t be shown in the document — see “Review each”}}
runBar.unshownWhy: {count, plural, one {# can’t be shown in the document ({reason}) — see “Review each”} other {# can’t be shown in the document ({reason}) — see “Review each”}}
runBar.docQuoteAll: {count, plural, one {All # edit by {agent}} other {All # edits by {agent}}}
runBar.reviseAfterTurn: Revises when the current turn ends.
runBar.dbTitle: {count, plural, one {{agent} proposes # change} other {{agent} proposes # changes}}
runBar.dbHintOffTable: {count, plural, one {# in another table — see “Review each”} other {# in other tables — see “Review each”}}
runBar.dbHint: nothing is applied until you accept
runBar.dbQuoteAll: {count, plural, one {All # change by {agent}} other {All # changes by {agent}}}
runBar.op.rowsInsert: Insert {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} into “{table}”
runBar.op.rowsImport: Import {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} into “{table}”
runBar.op.rowsUpdate: Update {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} in “{table}”
runBar.op.rowsDelete: Delete {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} from “{table}”
runBar.rejectOneWithNote: Reject this change with a note
changeList.label: Changes proposed by {agent}
changeList.unlisted: These changes can’t be listed one by one — use Accept all or Reject all above.
changeList.show: Show change {index, number} of {total, number} in the document
changeList.unshownDecideHere: can’t be shown inline — decide it here
reason.missing: its text is no longer there
reason.ambiguous: its text appears in more than one place
reason.chained: it edits text an earlier change adds; accept that one first
reason.invisible: it changes only the Markdown, not how the page looks
reason.unmatched: the preview would mark more than this change touches
reason.moved: the text it changes was just edited
note.label: What should change?
note.agentHint: The agent gets your note the next time it works here.
note.nextTurnHint: The co-author gets your note on its next turn.
diff.title: Changes by {agent}
diff.unchanged: No differences — the document is unchanged.
notice.undone: {count, plural, one {That change is back up for review.} other {Those # changes are back up for review.}}
notice.docConflict: {count, plural, one {That change no longer matches the document — it wasn’t applied.} other {# of those changes no longer match the document — they weren’t applied.}}
notice.dbConflict: {count, plural, one {That change no longer applies — the table moved on since it was proposed.} other {# of those changes no longer apply — the table moved on since they were proposed.}}
notice.blocked: {count, plural, one {That change builds on an earlier one in this run — accept that first (or use Accept all).} other {# of those changes build on earlier ones in this run — accept those first (or use Accept all).}}
notice.accepted: {count, plural, one {Accepted # change from {agent}.} other {Accepted # changes from {agent}.}}
notice.rejected: {count, plural, one {Rejected # change from {agent}.} other {Rejected # changes from {agent}.}}
notice.hunksFailed: Couldn’t load the individual changes for this run — you can still decide it as a whole.
notice.ledgerFailed: Couldn’t load agent changes for this item. Reload to try again.
notice.deferred: Some proposals couldn’t be read just now — they stay pending; try again shortly.
